# How to make an AI movie or short film with Claude Code, script to final cut

**Turn an idea into an AI short film: script, real references, moodboard, cast passports, approved stills, animated shots, sound and QA.**

**Typical cost** with `character-passport`: ~$0.05 per image (Nano Banana 2.1), ~$0.01 per voice take. Models are billed at provider price, and the agent shows an estimate before you pay. **Free, no key:** `video-script`, `find-references`, `video-moodboard`, `media-judge`, `video-project-github`.

<p><a href="../../video-script/README.md"><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_6cc42561ccd8.webp" alt="A script table titled &quot;Every line, sized to its seconds&quot; lists time codes, spoken lines, on-screen text and visuals, then zooms into the lines and the passing check." width="480"></a></p>

**Short answer:** start with [`video-script`](../../video-script/README.md): what is said, shown and heard in every beat, sized to the clock and the model. The other 8 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill video-script --skill find-references --skill video-moodboard --skill character-passport --skill varg-mockups --skill video-animate --skill video-sound --skill media-judge --skill video-project-github
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Make a 90-second AI short film about a lighthouse keeper who finds a robot on the beach. Start with the script and references, and stop for my approval after each step."*

## Steps

| | Skill | What it does here |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | [`video-script`](../../video-script/README.md) | What is said, shown and heard in every beat, sized to the clock and the model. <sub>no key · local</sub> |
| 2 | [`find-references`](../../find-references/README.md) | Real human-made references per job, with a 'never' board. <sub>no key · local</sub> |
| 3 | [`video-moodboard`](../../video-moodboard/README.md) | A look written in numbers (hex, Kelvin, lens mm), proven on test stills. <sub>no key</sub> |
| 4 | [`character-passport`](../../character-passport/README.md) | One paragraph per character and prop, pasted word for word into every prompt. <sub>varg key</sub> |
| 5 | [`varg-mockups`](../../varg-mockups/README.md) | A storyboard board of stills to approve before paying for video. <sub>varg key</sub> |
| 6 | [`video-animate`](../../video-animate/README.md) | Per-shot choice of code or AI video, 480p draft pass, cut to the locked track. <sub>varg key</sub> |
| 7 | [`video-sound`](../../video-sound/README.md) | Voices, SFX on the frame, music with a quiet part, measured mix. <sub>varg key</sub> |
| 8 | [`media-judge`](../../media-judge/README.md) | Measure the finished film: drift, banding, sync, loudness. <sub>no key · local</sub> |
| 9 | [`video-project-github`](../../video-project-github/README.md) | Private repo with a version after every approved step and the prompt, seed and cost of every take. <sub>no key</sub> |

## Requests to paste into your agent

- "Make a 90-second AI short film about a lighthouse keeper who finds a robot on the beach. Start with the script and references, and stop for my approval after each step."
- "Build a moodboard and character passports for my sci-fi short, then a storyboard board of stills."
- "Animate my approved stills with Seedance 2.5 at 480p first, then the keepers in 1080p."
- "Review my finished short before I post it: ./film.mp4"

## What you need

- The generation steps call the [varg API](https://varg.ai) (Seedance, Kling, Veo, GPT Image, ElevenLabs and more on one key). Sign in to the varg MCP with OAuth or set `VARG_API_KEY`. Models are billed at provider price, 1 credit = $0.01, and the agent shows an estimate before anything expensive.
- `character-passport`: ~$0.05 per image (Nano Banana 2.1), ~$0.01 per voice take.
- `varg-mockups`: ~$0.06–0.08 per Nano Banana 2.1 still, ~$0.23 per GPT Image 2.5 high-quality still.
- `video-animate`: ~$0.64–3.42 per 5 s Seedance 2.5 clip, 480p–1080p (estimate).
- `video-sound`: ~$0.01–0.02 per voice line, $0.01–0.06 per sound effect, $0.05 per 20 s music bed; mixing free.
- Any agent that reads Agent Skills: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and others ([install options](../../README.md#install)).

## FAQ

### Can you make a whole movie with AI?

A short film, yes, in stages: script, references, moodboard, cast, stills, animation, sound, review. Each stage ends with something you approve, so nothing more is spent until you say yes.

### How do I make AI video not look like AI slop?

Start from real references (find-references), write the look as numbers instead of 'cinematic' (video-moodboard checks test stills line by line, palette by ΔE), paste each character's passport word for word, and approve stills before any video.

### How do I keep characters the same across shots?

character-passport writes one paragraph per character with every visible detail, a turnaround sheet and six expressions, and its prompt builder refuses paraphrased passports.

### Seedance or Kling? One long take or short clips?

video-animate decides per shot whether code, AI video or both makes it, picks the model, and runs a cheap 480p pass before paying for quality.

### How do I check the film before posting?

media-judge reads every frame and reports facts with timestamps: broken frames, banding after a simulated X or YouTube upload, a face, outfit or light that changed, sound after the cut, loudness. No score out of 10.

### How do I not lose my project?

video-project-github keeps it in a private GitHub repo with a version after every approved step, big media stored outside git, and the prompt, model, seed and cost of every take, even if you have never used git.
